notes: boolean[] is one byte per flag in HotSpot and zero-filled by new; Arrays.fill sets 2..N (BitSet would pack bits, which the rules forbid).
Java arrays have int indices: p * p and multiple += p stay below 2^31 for N ≤ 200000000; the sum is a long.
Digits are checked explicitly because Integer.parseInt also accepts a leading '+'.
javac --release 25, run with java -cp on the Temurin JRE with default JVM flags; the 200 MB maximum fits the default max heap (a quarter of RAM).
